name: Gemini III
about: Gemini III (1965-024A), a crewed vehicle (Gemini), launched 1965 Mar 23. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (L).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (1965 Mar 23), held fixed
GCAT gives no site; the point stands in for the programme's usual landing or recovery area, from memory
